assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_IIDA_TENYA_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its ID-SUP-01 to ID-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Iida sections of the Class 1-A character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Iida entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Iida from the V01:p94-134 entrance-exam misjudgment and revision and the V02:p092-104 vote and cafeteria leadership and p153-155 USJ messenger role, through the V04:p017-019 rivalry choice, the V05:p124-125 notice of Tensei's injury, the V06:p103-189 Hosu revenge and correction and the V07:p042-100 apology, nerve-damage choice and prevention doctrine, the V10:p079-083 and p119 Kamino objection and V11:p020-023 and p173-175 extraction and sanction, V12:p175-176, the V15:p169-171 friendship offer, the V22:p047-048 Engine tuning, the V33:p061-063 relay, V34:p163-166, V36:p039-056 and the V38:p187-203 and V39:p047-050 transport of Shoto, to the V42:p133, p163 and p171-175 adult peer and professional pages, with ID-SUP-02's agency succession as an endpoint. Kept as separable states: earnest early student, privately vengeful brother, chastened post-Hosu student and adult professional; later outcomes are not moved earlier. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a motivational hierarchy (become a dependable hero worthy of the family name, protect others, fulfill concrete responsibilities, keep the standards that make collective action safe), a feared self (the privately reckless person who endangers the friends he claims to protect) and one explicit override condition: before the Stain correction, avenging Tensei displaces those priorities (ID01-ID03). The Class 1-A ledger locates the override and its repair (V06:p103-111, p121-125; V07:p042, p099-100). Not B: apart from the revenge override the priorities carry no weights or decision rules, and the only formal probe (ID-V01) tests one friends'-rescue proposal. Not D: the model is operational, revises 'rule obedience is his fixed highest value' against located countercases and states what flips his choice.

The model separates four states (earnest rule-oriented student, privately vengeful brother, chastened friend who uses his failure as a constraint, adult professional), and the Class 1-A ledger gives dated deltas with STRENGTHEN, REVISE or VALIDATE verdicts for V01-V07, V10-V12, V15, V22, V33-V34, V36, V38-V39 and V42; the readiness index dates each tier change (V10 moderate to strong, V33 strong to specialist_ready). The pivotal V05:p124 to V07:p100 to V10:p079-083 transition is dense and page-located. Not B: there is no Iida entry for V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37 or V40-V41, so most of the series' middle and the war's opening are unsampled, the adult state rests on V42:p133, p163 and p171-175 plus supplements, and all three artifacts are one project's work. Not D: the central transitions carry their knowledge differences.

Located Japanese formulations span registers: developmental rivalry 未熟者 and 挑戦する (V04:p017-019), the revenge intent この手で始末してやる and the claim 僕はインゲニウム (V06:p103-105, p124-125), the prevention vow 俺のような者を もうこれ以上 出さぬ為にも (V07:p100), the self-label 私的暴走 (V10:p079), 今度は俺が守るんだ (V10:p119), 俺の行動は 俺の夢の形でもある (V12:p176), the boundary-respecting offer 本当にどうしようもなくなったら 言ってくれ 友だちだろ (V15:p170), 同じ意志で 同じ歩調で (V33:p061) and 迷子を導く為にあるんだから (V38:p197). The model reports directly checked 俺 at V10:p079-080 and 僕 at p081, and the vocabulary ledger notes his formal register holding while his motive collapses in V06. Not B: there is no address-term or honorific inventory, the model refuses to infer a pronoun switch rule from two pages, and the probe left exact pronoun movement underdetermined. Not D: several registers are located with recipient and context.

Low-stakes windows: the class-representative vote (V02:p092-093), awkward post-Hosu humor with Todoroki (V07:p079-080, in the relationship ledger), checking on a distressed Midoriya (V15:p169-171), rejecting Shoto's unneeded apology (V36:p039-056), adult peer time with counseling and a ranking explanation (V42:p133, p163, p171-174) and the profile's daily kicking-technique exchanges with Midoriya (ID-SUP-01, editorial). Not C: most ordinary conduct is school-role or peer-support conduct, the model's 'comic excess in etiquette and earnestness' is not located, and domestic life is OPEN. Not E: several located low-stakes windows bear on him.

Directional, located deltas exist for many partners: Midoriya (V01:p94-134, V02:p101-104, V04:p017-019, V06-V07, V10:p079-083, p119, V15:p169-172, V33:p061-063), Todoroki (V06:p184-189, V07:p079-080, V36:p039-056, V38:p187-203, V39:p047-050), Tensei (V02:p097, V05:p178-179, V06, V07:p011, V12:p176, V22:p047-048, ID-SUP-02), Uraraka (V02:p101-104, p194), Aoyama (V12:p175-183, V34:p163-166), Manual (V06:p109-111) and Aizawa's sanction (V11:p173-175). The model's partner table states conditional behavior and what each relation does not license, and ID-V01 found relationship handling supported. Not A: Uraraka's and Aoyama's relations are thin, adult relations rest on V42 pages and the agency profile fact, and family beyond Tensei is mostly unspecified. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, repeated and bounded per partner.

Located self-accounts: the V04:p017-019 reason for opposing Midoriya, the stated revenge intent (V06:p103-105), choosing to keep left-hand nerve damage as a reminder (V07:p077-078), the V07:p100 prevention doctrine, the V10:p079-081 self-accusation and fear triggered by Midoriya's injuries recalling Tensei, and V12:p176's separation of inherited ideal from his own dream. Not B: the V06 grief state is mostly concealed and seen from outside (V06:p037-038), the ledger leaves the nerve-damage choice OPEN between accountability and self-punishment, and adult interiority is thin. Not D: central motives are given in his own words at several located points.

The model states a post-Stain decision policy for a friend's dangerous plan (ask for the concrete plan, name risks, insist on a limited noncombat role, join only to make the limits real) with flip conditions (a viable official response, bystanders at risk or a revenge-built plan move him toward refusal and reporting). It recurs in located cases: the USJ messenger role (V02:p153-155, p185-186), the pre-correction counterexample (V06:p121-125), V10:p079-083 and V11:p020-023, V12:p175-176, V33:p061-063 and the V38:p187-203 relay. ID-V01 found action partial and motive supported. Not A: the flip conditions are untested, joining is given only medium confidence, and combat choices outside transport and relay roles are thin. Not C: the policy is explicit, conditioned and repeatedly located.

His own stated reasons are located in distinct dilemmas: separating Stain's conviction from 粛清 (V07:p099-100), reasoning about 保護下 status and U.A.'s institutional responsibility before Kamino (V10:p079), accepting that a good outcome does not exonerate the action (V11:p173-175) and taking a betrayer's hand without erasing the harm (V34:p163-166); Manual's 私刑 warning, which he hears and overrides (V06:p109-111), is the located failure case. Not B: each dilemma type rests on one located case, and the model's only new-dilemma reconstruction is medium confidence on the actual choice. Not D: these are his reasons, with competing considerations named. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

Only local evidence: the relationship ledger records that he and Todoroki can share awkward humor after Hosu (V07:p079-080), and the model says ordinary life permits comic excess in etiquette and earnestness without locating an instance. Not D: one located occasion and an unlocated general statement; how he jokes or plays is not established.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted supplements; V10:p079-083 was directly rechecked and the V42 entries cite directly rechecked pages. Not C: the Class 1-A ledger and readiness index carry no Iida entry for 24 of the 42 volumes (V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37, V40-V41), so the evidence set cannot tell whether he is absent or unsampled there; the model has only eight evidence atoms; the supplement claims are editorial or profile facts; and the artifacts share one authorship. Not E: the sampled volumes include every pivotal transition.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REVISEs 'rule obedience is his fixed highest value', REJECTs 'accepting the Kamino plan means abandoning rules' and refuses to generalize constrained participation into approval of vigilantism (ID03); bodily limits on Engine speed survive tuning and equipment (ID06-ID07, V22:p048, ID-SUP-03); he is not granted confidential OFA knowledge from noticing distress (ID05); V42:p171-175 shows care has not made him universally tactful; and the vocabulary ledger warns that his intact formal speech in V06 hid an unregulated motive. The readiness index warns that some historical rows are carry-forward defects. Not B: no independent audit is part of the evidence set.

Entries are page-located by volume with the V31 page convention stated, and the model requires a chronology lock on two variables: whether Tensei has been injured and whether Iida has already lived through the Stain rescue and correction. ID-V01 freezes inputs with Git blob IDs at a source lock. Not B: apart from the probe there is no state table with knowledge cutoffs or enumerated leakage checks, many volumes are unsampled, and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates real formulations in several registers, but the model says pronouns are not invariant and no switch rule can be inferred, that names, honorifics and sentence-final force must follow a relation it does not inventory, and that generated dialogue is an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Iida's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: earnest early student (before V05:p124), privately vengeful brother (V05:p124 to V06:p189), chastened post-Hosu student and class representative (V07 onward), or adult professional (V42); the revenge state is not moved later and the learned restraint is not moved earlier.

The interlocutor is Midoriya, Todoroki, Tensei, Uraraka, Aoyama or another Class 1-A classmate, a supervising teacher or a field colleague, handled as the model's partner table and the relationship ledger give for that state; no romantic partner or detailed household is invented.

The setting is school, a hero operation, a rescue or a peer gathering, with Tensei's condition, what classmates have disclosed, the agreed safety terms and his Engine and bodily limits stated before any choice is predicted.
Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels; it produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early student before V05:p124, vengeful brother V05:p124 to V06:p189, post-Hosu student from V07, or adult professional at V42, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Midoriya, Todoroki, Tensei, Uraraka, Aoyama, another Class 1-A classmate, a supervising teacher or a field colleague, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.
setting_constraints: School, hero operation, rescue or peer gathering
Tensei's state, disclosed knowledge, agreed safety terms and Engine limits stated
No domestic, romantic or invented-family setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's own conditional reconstruction (post-Stain Iida and friends proposing to enter danger for a missing classmate) states likely actions, confidence and the conditions that flip the choice, which supports narrow novel scenes. The single probe is retrospective and nonblind and covers that one situation type.

conditions: The setting is low-stakes contact with a classmate or adult peer, with the state named.
Output keeps earnest, explicit care that respects what the other person has not disclosed, permits collegial disagreement, and does not make every social sentence a reprimand.
Domestic life, leisure, romance and family routine beyond the agency succession are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Narrowly supported by located windows (V07:p079-080, V15:p169-171, V36:p039-056, V42:p133, p163, p171-174) and the editorial ID-SUP-01 profile; the model marks detailed private life OPEN.

conditions: The dilemma concerns procedure against rescue, a friend's risky plan, an offender's conviction against method, or accountability after harm, in a school or hero setting, with what Iida knows stated.
Output keeps procedure as protective rather than absolute, separates constrained participation from endorsing the risky plan, and does not treat a good outcome as exoneration.
Private, family and political dilemmas are not predicted, and the pre-correction revenge state is not used for a later dilemma.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in V07:p099-100, V10:p079, V11:p173-175 and V34:p163-166, with V06:p109-111 as the failure case, support bounded dilemmas of rules, rescue and accountability only.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the model marks romance OPEN. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is class-representative leadership, a supervised operation, a rescue relay or transport role, or adult hero work, with the state and his Engine and bodily limits stated.

Output preserves function-first service (moving or reaching someone for a defined rescue purpose), visible short reassurance under command responsibility, and support that does not take over another person's task.
Adult agency leadership is used only as the ID-SUP-02 profile fact; leadership failures, exact combat outcomes and agency management practice are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: His most densely evidenced domain: crowd leadership and role acceptance (V02:p092-104, p153-155), noncombat extraction (V11:p020-023), search and coordination (V12:p175-176), relay (V33:p061-063) and the V38-V39 transport of Shoto, with adult continuity at V42:p133, p163 and p171-174. READY was considered and rejected: no professional choice outside the friends'-rescue probe was tested by a frozen prediction, and adult professional evidence is a few pages and profile facts.

known_limits.statement: The privately vengeful state runs from Tensei's injury (V05:p124-125) to the Hosu correction (V06:p184-189); there he attacks the offender before the victim and overrides Manual's 私怨 warning. That state is not moved later, and the later learned restraint is not moved into it.

Joining the Kamino extraction under a noncombat brake (V10:p079-083; V11:p020-023) does not approve vigilantism or abandon rules; he accepted that the outcome did not exonerate the action (V11:p173-175).

Engine speed is trained, time-limited and bodily constrained; Recipro Turbo lasts about ten minutes and its acquisition cost 激痛と忍耐 (V22:p047-048), and improved equipment does not abolish those limits (ID06-ID07, ID-SUP-03).
Directly checked V10:p079-080 uses 俺 and p081 uses 僕; this rules out an always-僕 template but establishes no switch rule.
His formal speech can stay intact while his motive collapses; in V06 he minimized his distress to classmates (V06:p037-038), so polite procedural register is not evidence of a regulated state.
Noticing a friend's distress licenses care, not knowledge: he offers help without demanding protected information (V15:p169-171, ID05), and early school scenes do not grant him OFA secrets.

In the V38:p187-203 and V39:p047-050 relay his task is to carry Shoto to the place Shoto's capacity is needed; he is not interchangeable with Shoto at the family confrontation or with Midoriya's relation to Shigaraki.
Adult care coexists with objection: V42:p171-175 shows him still correcting competitive rescue timing.
Keeping his left-hand nerve damage until he becomes a 本当のヒーロー (V07:p077-078) is left OPEN by the ledger between productive accountability and self-punishment; a reconstruction does not settle it.
In the adult endpoint equipment-supported Tensei returns as Tenya's sidekick in the agency Tenya heads; Tensei is not simulated as permanently absent or as Tenya's current boss (ID-SUP-02).

The single formal probe ID-V01 is a retrospective chronological holdout by an analyst who had read later manga; action and speech were only partly supported and exact pronoun movement was underdetermined.
The readiness index's specialist_ready label measures breadth by the project's own rule and contains historical carry-forward defects; it is an input, not this assessment's tier.

The model marks detailed adult family life, romance and responses to leadership failure OPEN beyond the agency role reversal; the evidence set cannot say how he behaves in domestic or private adult settings. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
The ledgers carry no Iida entry for V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37 or V40-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The supplemental evidence reconciliation ledger, the all-character reconciliation audit and the deep readings linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not rechecked here; anime material lies outside this evidence set.

dimensions.note: The model states a motivational hierarchy (a dependable hero worthy of the family name; protect others; fulfill concrete responsibilities; keep the standards that make collective action safe), a feared self (the privately reckless person who endangers the friends he claims to protect) and a decision policy for a friend's dangerous plan: ask for the concrete plan, name risks, insist on a limited noncombat role, and join only to make the limits real, with flip conditions (a viable official response, bystanders at risk, or a plan built on revenge move him toward refusal and reporting). The ledgers supply located discriminators: family injury narrows his moral field so that he attacks the offender before the victim and overrides Manual's 私怨 warning (V06:p103-125); once he has lived through the Hosu correction, the same rescue trigger produces self-accusation, fear for friends and constrained participation (V10:p079-083, p119); concealed distress in a friend produces care without demand for protected facts (V15:p169-171); a specialist task produces transport without appropriating the outcome (V38:p187-203, V39:p047-050). The model predicts his own mistakes: premature social judgment from formal seriousness (V01:p94-106), revenge narrowing, shame-driven overstrictness, and adult tactlessness (V42:p171-175). Not A: the single probe is retrospective and only partly supported on action, and the domain is school, hero and rescue settings. Not C: the evidence explains which conditions change his response (Tensei's state, whether the Hosu correction has happened, the credibility of an exit or official alternative, the disclosure boundary, role division) and says where that explanation stops.

The model keeps four states (earnest rule-oriented student; privately vengeful brother; chastened friend who uses his failure as a constraint; adult professional), and the Class 1-A ledger gives dated deltas with explicit verdicts: V01 baseline, V02 functional leadership (p092-104, p153-155), V04 deliberate rivalry (p017-019), V05 family-harm opening (p124-125, p178-179), V06 concealed revenge and first reorientation (p037-189), V07 apology, accountability and doctrine (p011, p042, p077-078, p099-100), V10 transferable prevention (p079-083, p119), V11-V12, V15, V22 tuning, V33 shared-pace relay (p061-063), V34, V36, V38-V39 transport, and V42 adult peers (p133, p163, p171-175, after the p130 time gap). The readiness index locates the steps moderate (V01-V09) to strong (V10) to specialist_ready (V33). The revenge state has a located beginning and end (V05:p124 to V06:p189). Not A: there is no Iida entry for V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37 or V40-V41. Not C: each state is separately evidenced and fenced by chronology.

The vocabulary ledger characterizes his register as formal and procedural, with concise reassurance under command responsibility, and warns that his formal speech stayed intact while his motive collapsed (V06). Located strings span states: 未熟者 and 挑戦する (V04:p017-019), この手で始末してやる and 僕はインゲニウム (V06:p103-105, p124-125), 俺のような者を もうこれ以上 出さぬ為にも (V07:p100), 私的暴走 (V10:p079), 今度は俺が守るんだ (V10:p119), 俺の行動は 俺の夢の形でもある (V12:p176), 本当にどうしようもなくなったら 言ってくれ 友だちだろ (V15:p170), 同じ意志で 同じ歩調で and 余計なお世話ってのは ヒーローの本質なんだろ (V33:p061-063), and 迷子を導く為にあるんだから (V38:p197). The model states that pronouns are not invariant (俺 at V10:p079-080, 僕 at p081) and that no switch rule follows from two pages, and that names, honorifics and sentence-final force must follow the target relation without supplying that mapping. Not B: there is no relation- or state-specific address and pronoun rule, and the adult register has no located strings. Not D: located formulations cover every major state and the register description is explicit.

Low-stakes windows are distributed: the class-representative vote (V02:p092-093), awkward humor with Todoroki after Hosu (V07:p079-080), checking on a distressed Midoriya (V15:p169-171), rejecting Shoto's unnecessary apology (V36:p039-056), adult peer counseling and a rankings explanation (V42:p133, p163), and the editorial ID-SUP-01 daily kicking-technique exchanges with Midoriya. The model says ordinary life permits comic excess in etiquette and earnestness and keeps detailed private life OPEN. Not C: no conditional account of low-stakes behavior is given beyond peer care. Not E: the windows recur across the series.

The partner table and the relationship ledger give directional, located deltas: Midoriya (premature judgment then revision, V01:p94-134; leadership reference and transfer of the presidency, V02:p101-104; rivalry as respect, V04:p017-019; rescue and reciprocal apology, V06-V07:p042-043; reciprocal constraint, V10:p079-083, p119; boundary-respecting care, V15:p169-172; the receiving hand, V33:p061-063), Todoroki (corrective recognition, V06:p184-189; humor, V07:p079-080; burden correction, V36:p039-056; differentiated transport, V38:p187-203, V39:p047-050), Tensei (leadership template, V02:p097; injury and role reversal, V05:p178-179; vengeance identity, V06; service ideal, V07:p011; conditional craft inheritance, V22:p047-048; adult sidekick, ID-SUP-02), Aoyama (refusal to abandon, V12:p175-183), Manual (heard but not obeyed, V06:p109-111) and Uraraka (V02:p101-104, p194). Not A: relations with adults outside these supervisors, with romantic partners and with family beyond Tensei are thin. Not C: each relation has partner-specific, repeated conditioning.

Located self-accounts carry his inner reasoning: why he opposes Midoriya in the cavalry battle (V04:p017-019), the stated revenge intent (V06:p103-105), choosing to keep left-hand nerve damage as a reminder (V07:p077-078), the V07:p100 prevention doctrine, the V10:p079-081 self-accusation and the image of Tensei triggered by Midoriya's injuries, and 俺の夢の形 (V12:p176). The ledger leaves the meaning of the nerve-damage choice OPEN between accountability and self-punishment, and the probe's emotional-trajectory axis rests on expressed concern. Not B: affect between those located self-accounts is inferred from action. Not D: the self-accounts are analyzed for their causal role across states.

Interpersonal and physical conflict are located with conditions: messenger role when leaving the battlefield is the highest-value rescue action (V02:p153-155, p185-186) and tactical inference against Kurogiri (V02:p194); revenge engagement that ignores the victim (V06:p121-125); constrained participation in the Kamino extraction as propulsion rather than combat (V11:p020-023); refusal to abandon a classmate (V12:p175-176); the receiving hand in a coordinated relay (V33:p061-063); time-critical transport at physical cost (V38:p187-203, V39:p047-050). The model binds Engine speed as trained, time-limited and bodily constrained (Recipro Turbo about ten minutes, V22:p047-048) and states the flip conditions for a dangerous plan. Not A: few direct combat outcomes against a capable opponent after V06 are sampled and adult field conflict is unshown. Not C: the policy, its triggers and its physical limits are explicit and repeated.

His own stated reasons are located in distinct dilemmas and discriminated by condition: he separates Stain's conviction from the illegitimate method 粛清 (V07:p099-100); he reasons through 保護下 status and U.A.'s institutional responsibility before Kamino while treating friends' safety as the decisive stake (V10:p079-081); he accepts that a good outcome does not exonerate the action (V11:p173-175); he extends friendship to a classmate who has caused real harm without claiming the past acts disappear (V34:p163-166). The Hosu failure (V06:p109-125, overriding Manual's legal and moral warning) is the located counter-case, and the model REVISEs rule obedience as a fixed value into a protective normative policy changed by that failure. Not A: political, family and private dilemmas are unsampled, and the model's medium confidence for joining a risky plan depends on stated conditions. Not C: positions are reasoned, repeated and change with identified conditions.

Only local evidence: awkward humor with Todoroki after Hosu (V07:p079-080, relationship ledger) and the model's unlocated statement that ordinary life permits comic excess in etiquette and earnestness. Not D: there is no distributed body of humorous conduct.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age supplements; V10:p079-083 was directly rechecked. The Class 1-A ledger and readiness index carry Iida entries for V01-V07, V10-V12, V15, V22, V33-V34, V36, V38-V39 and V42; the model adds atoms for the same arcs. Not C: no Iida entry covers V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37 or V40-V41, so this evidence set does not show whether those are intervals of minor presence or unanalyzed action. Not E: every arc in which he is a principal has located, dedicated analysis.

Affirmative located limits: rule obedience is not his fixed highest value (V06:p109-125, model REVISE); constrained participation in Kamino is not approval of vigilantism (V10:p079-083, V11:p020-023, p173-175; model REJECT); formal register is not evidence of a regulated state (V06:p037-038, vocabulary ledger); noticing distress does not grant protected knowledge (V15:p169-171); his transport role is not authorship of Shoto's or Midoriya's confrontation (V38-V39); Engine speed has trained, temporal and bodily limits (V22:p047-048, ID-SUP-03); pronouns are not invariant (V10:p079-081); adult care has not made him universally tactful (V42:p171-175). Not A: several limits are interpretive bounds rather than tested predictions. Not C: each is located and stated as a rule.

The model requires a chronology lock on two variables (whether Tensei has been injured and whether Iida has already lived through the Stain rescue and correction), keeps four states, and fences the probe ID-V01 to V05-V07 and V09 inputs with Git blob IDs at a source lock, excluding V10 and later relays. The ledger dates every delta by volume and page, states the V31 page convention, and the V42 entry separates pre-gap and post-gap pages at the p130 caption. Not A: the unsampled intervals leave state between V12-V15, V15-V22 and V22-V33 undocumented. Not C: the boundaries are explicit and enforced in the probe.

The missing pronoun and address mapping is productive uncertainty about exact wording and is carried by the conditions.

known_limits.statement: The privately vengeful state runs from Tensei's injury (V05:p124-125) to the Hosu correction (V06:p184-189); in it he attacks the offender before the victim and overrides Manual's 私怨 warning. That state is not moved later, and the post-Hosu restraint is not moved earlier.

Joining the Kamino extraction under a noncombat brake (V10:p079-083; V11:p020-023) does not approve vigilantism or abandon rules; he accepted that the outcome did not exonerate the action (V11:p173-175).

Engine speed is trained, time-limited and bodily constrained: Recipro Turbo lasts about ten minutes and its acquisition cost 激痛と忍耐 (V22:p047-048), and improved equipment does not abolish those limits (ID-SUP-03).
Directly checked V10:p079-080 uses 俺 and p081 uses 僕; this rules out an always-僕 template but establishes no switch rule.
His formal speech can stay intact while his motive collapses; in V06 he minimized his distress to classmates (V06:p037-038), so polite procedural register is not evidence of a regulated state.
Noticing a friend's distress licenses care, not knowledge: he offers help without demanding protected information (V15:p169-171, ID05), and early school scenes do not grant him One For All secrets.

In the V38:p187-203 and V39:p047-050 relay his task is to carry Shoto to the place Shoto's capacity is needed; he is not interchangeable with Shoto at the family confrontation or with Midoriya in relation to Shigaraki.
Adult care coexists with objection: V42:p171-175 shows him still correcting competitive rescue timing.
Keeping his left-hand nerve damage until he becomes a 本当のヒーロー (V07:p077-078) is left OPEN by the ledger between productive accountability and self-punishment; a reconstruction does not settle it.
In the adult endpoint equipment-supported Tensei returns as Tenya's sidekick in the agency Tenya heads; Tensei is not simulated as permanently absent or as Tenya's current boss (ID-SUP-02).

The single formal probe ID-V01 is a retrospective chronological holdout by an analyst who had read later manga. Motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling were supported; action and speech were partial, because constrained joining depended on newly agreed limits and exact pronoun movement was underdetermined. It shows the conditional policy accommodating the outcome without predicting the exact negotiation.
The readiness index's specialist_ready label measures breadth by the project's own rule; it is an input, not this assessment's tier.

The model marks detailed adult family life, romance and responses to leadership failure OPEN beyond the agency role reversal; the evidence set cannot say how he behaves in domestic or private adult settings.
The ledgers carry no Iida entry for V08-V09, V13-V14, V16-V21, V23-V32, V35, V37 or V40-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.
